newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates ease to 27 pct by session's end.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates ease to 27 pct by session's end.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates closed weaker on Wednesday as takers disappeared from the market by the end of the session, dealers said.
The overnight rates finished at 27 percent, down from 28 percent at the opening and similarly 28 percent at Tuesday's close.
"Lenders overweighed takers, who apparently disappeared from the market," said Sandor Szatmari of Unicbank.
In the early part of the session lenders and takers were mostly in balance keeping rates around 28 percent in what dealers called "play of nerves."

This week banks were said boosting their mandatory forint reserves ahead of tax payments on Friday and preparing for those days when they cannot do any business due to Christmas holiday, dealers said.
